messages:
maria.g: Vendor confirmed pen test window Thu 11:00-15:00 PT. Need plan: RBAC for assessors, limited KMS decrypt, and audit export. Who volunteers to run ops during window?
ashok: I can take RBAC changes. Prefer ephemeral role with explicit TTL.
sam: I'll handle the evidence exports and presigned links. We'll avoid sharing keys.
lia: KMS guidance: create an ephemeral CMK with Grant tokens for the vendor; don't give kms:CreateGrant broadly. Also ensure decrypt operations are logged to CloudTrail and forwarded to SIEM.
maria.g: Good call. Action items: 1) create role pt_vendor_ephemeral (4h) 2) ephemeral CMK + grant 3) presigned evidence links with 72h expiry 4) snapshot logs before window
ashok: Drafting IAM role. Quick policy question: do we allow s3:GetObject only for evidence prefix?
sam: Yes, limit to arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/acme/* and block DeleteObject.
lia: Also restrict access to the vendor ASN/IP range for the duration via bucket policy.
ashok: Posting policy stub: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/acme/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/ephemeral-cmk-id"],
      "Condition": {"NumericLessThanEquals": {"aws:TokenIssueTime": "4h"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
maria.g: Nice. @lia can you set up a CloudWatch metric filter for KMS 'AccessDenied' events during the window and a PagerDuty escalation to sec-oncall?
lia: On it. I'll also configure CloudTrail to push a full snapshot to secure S3 before the test and enable log integrity checks.
security-bot: Please open ticket SEC-PT-497 with checklist: RBAC, CMK grant, S3 policy, IP allowlist, log snapshot, evidence reading room.
sam: I created the reading room VM and placed `pt-readonly` user creds there. Presigned link posted to SEC-PT-497.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor. If we see multiple KMS Denied spikes, we follow the pen-test runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pen-test-ops.
maria.g: Vendor requested a 48h retest buffer. Recommend we tentatively reserve same time next Tue 11:00-13:00.
ashok: Role created and TTL restricted. I added tags: pt=acme, owner=ashok. Posted role ARN in SEC-PT-497.
lia: CMK created and grant issued with two-week auto-revoke. I limited the grant to the vendor principal.
security-bot: Audit entry: RBAC change recorded at 1776002345 by infra-audit. Grant logged at 1776002401.
sam: Evidence export test passed. Presigned link valid for 72h: (link in ticket).
maria.g: Great work. Dry run tomorrow 10:00 — please join. We'll do a short checklist review 09:45.
ops-oncall: I'll be there and will standby for PD alerts.
